summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Anfield Energy Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting a press release about the completion of drilling monitoring wells at its Shootaring Canyon Mill and Slick Rock Mine Complex. The press release describes operational milestones for environmental monitoring and project advancement, not a special situation transaction. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or other special situation event is disclosed. The filing is an operational update with no deal terms, strategic review, or capital structure change. Accordingly, no special-situation category applies.
